final_answer: The bug was in `_next_offset()` in `challenge/diag/pager.py`. The original code used `>=` which caused the cursor to be set to `offset + returned + 1` even when the returned items reached the end of the list. The fix was to change `>=` to `>` so that when `offset + returned == total` (exactly at the end), the function returns `None` instead of computing an invalid next offset. This ensures the final page has no cursor, while still correctly computing the next offset for intermediate pages.
